title: MACE content file
description: Any file in a pack other than its manifest. Every key is optional and a file may mix collections freely; the loader merges by id.

AdjustStat.title: AdjustStat

AdvanceQuest.description: Move a quest to a given stage, or to its next one.
AdvanceQuest.title: AdvanceQuest

AdvanceTime.description: Push the world clock forward — resting, waiting, a long conversation.
AdvanceTime.title: AdvanceTime

ApplyModifier.description: Apply a temporary stat modifier, the way a potion or a spell would.
ApplyModifier.title: ApplyModifier

AtLocation.description: The actor is at a location.
AtLocation.title: AtLocation

AttachAlly.description: Add an entity to the player's party, optionally until a condition holds.
AttachAlly.title: AttachAlly

Chance.description: A weighted coin flip on the surrounding content's RNG stream.

Choice.description:
One option offered to the player.

Attributes
----------
prompt : str
    The option text.
when : tuple of Condition or None
    Conditions required for the choice to be available.
show_when_unavailable : bool
    Show the choice greyed out rather than hiding it, so the player can see
    what they are missing.
unavailable_hint : str or None
    Why it is unavailable — "(You'd need ten gold.)"
goto : str or None
    The scene this choice leads to.
effects : tuple of Effect
    Inline effects, for one-liners not worth a scene of their own.
Choice.title: Choice

ClimateOverride.description:
A hard weather override for one place.

It is always winter on the Dark Mountain, whatever the season is doing in
the lowlands. This bypasses the climate model rather than biasing it.

Attributes
----------
condition : str or None
    The weather condition that always holds here.
day_part : str or None
    A day part that always holds here — for caves and deep forest.
locked : bool
    Whether the override resists weather fronts moving through.
ClimateOverride.title: ClimateOverride

CombatAssignment.description:
How an actor fights.

Attributes
----------
profile : str
    The combat profile that supplies moves, patterns, and temperament.
CombatAssignment.title: CombatAssignment

Condition.description: One condition, written as a single-key mapping.

ConditionGroup.description: A group of conditions, for `all` and `any`.

ContainerProps.description:
The `kind: container` block.

Attributes
----------
capacity : int or None
    How much it holds. `None` means no limit.
contents : tuple of InventoryEntry
    What is inside at game start.
ContainerProps.title: ContainerProps

Damage.description:
A weapon's damage range.

Attributes
----------
min, max : float
    The bounds of a single hit, before stats and gear.
type : str
    Author-defined: `slash`, `pierce`, `plasma`.
Damage.title: Damage

DayPartIs.description: The world clock is in one of these parts of the day.

DescriptionLine.description:
One candidate line of description.

Attributes
----------
text : str
    What the player reads.
when : tuple of Condition or None
    Conditions that must hold for this line to be chosen. `None` makes it
    the fallback.

oneOf.description:
One candidate line of description.

Attributes
----------
text : str
    What the player reads.
when : tuple of Condition or None
    Conditions that must hold for this line to be chosen. `None` makes it
    the fallback.
May be written as the bare value shown, which is the same as the mapping form with every other field left out.
oneOf.title: DescriptionLine

DismissAlly.description: Remove an entity from the player's party.
DismissAlly.title: DismissAlly

Effect.description: One effect, written as a single-key mapping.

Entity.description:
Anything the world contains that content can refer to by id.

Extending another definition makes name optional here — the parent supplies them.

$remove.description: Keys to drop from the inherited definition.

Entity.title: Entity

EnvResponse.description:
How an entity answers the weather, the dark, or the season.

Attributes
----------
when : tuple of Condition
    When this response applies.
modify : tuple of StatModifier
    Adjustments held for as long as the condition does.
effects : tuple of Effect
    One-shot effects fired on entering the condition.
EnvResponse.title: EnvResponse

Exit.description:
A way out of a location.

Attributes
----------
to : str
    The destination location.
route : str or None
    The route taken. Omitted, the loader synthesizes a one-tick route.
label : str or None
    Overrides the default "Travel to X".
when : tuple of Condition or None
    Conditions gating the exit — a locked gate, a quest requirement.
hidden_until : tuple of Condition or None
    Conditions revealing a secret passage.
Exit.title: Exit

ExprCondition.description: An author expression, parsed at load time.

FlagIs.description: An entity's boolean flag has a given value.
FlagIs.title: FlagIs

Game.description: The contents of a game pack's `game.yml`, under its `game:` key.
Game.title: Game

GameRules.description:
The structural choices a game makes about its own simulation.

Attributes
----------
vital_pool : str
    The pool whose exhaustion means death.
effort_pool : str
    The pool combat actions are paid from.
combat_mode : {'reflex', 'tactical', 'auto'}
    The default combat presentation. The player may override it.
death_is_permanent : bool
    Whether death ends the playthrough or returns to a scene.
survival : tuple of str
    Which survival systems are on: `exposure`, `rest`, `hunger`, `thirst`.
    Empty disables them all.
economy : {'simple', 'market'}
    `simple` prices from each item's `value`; `market` runs the full
    supply-and-demand model.
GameRules.title: GameRules

HasItem.description: The actor carries at least `qty` of an item.
HasItem.title: HasItem

InventoryEntry.description:
A stack of one item.

Attributes
----------
item : str
    Reference to the item entity.
qty : int
    How many.
InventoryEntry.title: InventoryEntry

ItemProps.description:
The `kind: item` block.

Attributes
----------
weight : float or None
    Carried weight.
stackable : bool or None
    Whether copies collapse into one inventory entry.
equip_slot : str or None
    Which slot it occupies when equipped.
damage : Damage or None
    For weapons.
armor : float or None
    Damage reduction when worn.
moves : tuple of str
    Combat moves this item grants its wielder.
use : ItemUse or None
    What using it from the inventory does.
value : float or None
    Base trade value, the anchor a market prices from.
ItemProps.title: ItemProps

ItemTransfer.description: Give an actor items, or take them away.
ItemTransfer.title: ItemTransfer

ItemUse.description:
What happens when an item is used from the inventory.

Attributes
----------
effects : tuple of Effect
    What using it does.
consumed : bool
    Whether the item is spent in the using.
ItemUse.title: ItemUse

Location.description:
A place in the world.

Extending another definition makes name optional here — the parent supplies them.

$remove.description: Keys to drop from the inherited definition.

Location.title: Location

MapPosition.description:
Where a location sits on the map view.

Attributes
----------
x, y : float
    Map coordinates. Optional overall — the layout engine can infer them.
MapPosition.title: MapPosition

Move.description: Put an actor somewhere else, without travelling there.
Move.title: Move

PlayerSetup.description:
Who the player is and where they start.

Attributes
----------
entity : str
    An entity with `playable: true`.
start_location : str
    Where the game opens.
creation_points : int
    Points the player may spend on stats marked `customizable`.
backgrounds : tuple of str
    Optional starting variants offered at character creation.
PlayerSetup.title: PlayerSetup

PortalProps.description:
The `kind: portal` block.

Attributes
----------
route : str
    The route this portal gates.
requires_item : str or None
    A key, a writ, a password token.
PortalProps.title: PortalProps

Quest.description: An objective with stages, a journal, and consequences.
Quest.title: Quest

QuestAtStage.description: A quest is currently at a given stage.
QuestAtStage.title: QuestAtStage

QuestRef.description: A quest has completed, or failed.

QuestStage.description:
One step of a quest.

Attributes
----------
id : str
    Stage id, referenced by the `questStage` condition.
journal : str
    What the player reads in the quest log while this stage is current.
complete : tuple of Condition
    Conditions that advance to the next stage.
fail : tuple of Condition or None
    Conditions that fail the whole quest.
on_enter : tuple of Effect
    Effects fired when this stage becomes current.
deadline_ticks : int or None
    Shorthand for a tick-count fail condition.
QuestStage.title: QuestStage

Reveal.description: Make a location known, so it appears on the map and in travel menus.
Reveal.title: Reveal

Route.description: A connection between two locations, with a length.
Route.title: Route

SayLine.description:
One line of scene narration.

Attributes
----------
text : str
    What the player reads.
when : tuple of Condition or None
    Conditions that must hold for this line to be spoken at all.
pause : bool
    Whether the front-end waits for the player before going on. Pacing is a
    presentation concern, but where the beats fall is the author's call.

oneOf.description:
One line of scene narration.

Attributes
----------
text : str
    What the player reads.
when : tuple of Condition or None
    Conditions that must hold for this line to be spoken at all.
pause : bool
    Whether the front-end waits for the player before going on. Pacing is a
    presentation concern, but where the beats fall is the author's call.
May be written as the bare value shown, which is the same as the mapping form with every other field left out.
oneOf.title: SayLine

Scene.description: A unit of interaction: some narration, some changes, and what comes next.
Scene.title: Scene

SetDisposition.description: Change how an entity feels about the player.
SetDisposition.title: SetDisposition

SetFlag.description: Set or clear a boolean flag on an entity.
SetFlag.title: SetFlag

SetStat.description: Set a stat or pool to an absolute value.
SetStat.title: SetStat

SetVar.description: Set a game variable, readable from expressions as `vars.name`.
SetVar.title: SetVar

StartCombat.description: Hand control to the combat system.
StartCombat.title: StartCombat

Stat.description:
A single ability or pool, before anything acts on it.

Attributes
----------
base : float
    The value with nothing acting on it.
max : float or None
    Cap. Defaults to 100 for abilities; pools should set it explicitly.
min : float
    Floor. Defaults to 0.
customizable : bool
    Whether the player may spend creation points here at game start.
growth : {'none', 'slow', 'normal', 'fast'}
    How fast the stat improves through use.
Stat.title: Stat

StatCompare.description: An actor's effective stat is at or beyond a threshold.
StatCompare.title: StatCompare

StatModifier.description:
An adjustment to a stat while some condition holds.

Attributes
----------
stat : str
    Which stat is affected.
add : float or None
    A flat adjustment.
mult : float or None
    A multiplier, applied after `add`.
StatModifier.title: StatModifier

TransferContents.description: Move everything in one container or actor into another.
TransferContents.title: TransferContents

Waypoint.description:
A place passed through on the way to somewhere else.

Attributes
----------
location : str
    A real location definition — waypoints are locations.
at_tick : int or None
    How far into the journey it is reached. Defaults to even spacing.
stop_if : tuple of Condition or None
    Conditions that force a stop here, such as a bridge with a troll on it.
encounters : str or None
    A waypoint-specific table, rolled in addition to the route's.
Waypoint.title: Waypoint

WeatherIs.description: The current weather is one of these conditions.

WeatherTagIs.description: The current weather carries one of these tags — `wet`, `cold`, `dark`.

WorldSetup.description:
How time and place are configured at the start of a playthrough.

Attributes
----------
minutes_per_tick : int
    How much world time one tick represents. Sets the pace of everything:
    travel, weather, hunger, the seven days you have left.
calendar : str or None
    The calendar governing days, seasons, and day parts.
start_tick : int
    The tick the game opens on — dawn of day one, or mid-morning.
start_season : str or None
    Which season the game opens in.
start_region : str or None
    Which region seeds the weather model.
WorldSetup.title: WorldSetup
